name: Find the range of a data set
description: Student can find the range of a numerical data set.
exampleOfSuccess: The student finds the range as the difference between the highest and lowest values.
commonError: Student gives the highest value, or counts the data points.
checkpointTask: Give numerical data sets. Ask the student to find the range of each.

name: Compare distributions by mode and range
description: Student can compare two data sets in terms of mode and range.
exampleOfSuccess: The student says one class has a higher mode but a smaller range.
commonError: Student compares single values without using mode or range.
checkpointTask: Give two data sets. Ask the student to compare them by mode and range.

name: Use a comparative display
description: Student can use a side-by-side display to compare two data sets.
exampleOfSuccess: The student makes a side-by-side column graph to compare two groups.
commonError: Student makes separate displays that cannot be easily compared.
checkpointTask: Give two data sets. Ask the student to make a comparative display.

name: Compare the shape of distributions
description: Student can compare the shape of two distributions in context.
exampleOfSuccess: The student says one data set is spread out while the other is bunched.
commonError: Student reads single values without describing the shape.
checkpointTask: Show two distributions. Ask the student to compare their shapes.

name: Identify a statistical argument in the media
description: Student can identify a statistically informed argument in traditional or digital media.
exampleOfSuccess: The student points out a claim in an article backed by a graph.
commonError: Student cannot separate the statistical claim from the rest of the text.
checkpointTask: Show a media item with statistics. Ask the student to identify the statistical argument.

name: Spot a misleading data representation
description: Student can identify a potentially misleading data representation.
exampleOfSuccess: The student notices a graph with a truncated axis exaggerates a difference.
commonError: Student takes the display at face value without questioning it.
checkpointTask: Show data displays including misleading ones. Ask the student which might mislead and why.

name: Critique a method or conclusion
description: Student can discuss and critique the methods or conclusions in a statistical report.
exampleOfSuccess: The student questions whether a small sample supports a broad conclusion.
commonError: Student accepts the conclusion without considering the method.
checkpointTask: Show a statistical claim. Ask the student to critique the method or conclusion.

name: Evaluate a data representation
description: Student can evaluate how well a representation supports an argument.
exampleOfSuccess: The student says the graph supports the claim but a different scale would change the impression.
commonError: Student evaluates the claim without reference to the representation.
checkpointTask: Show an argument and its display. Ask the student to evaluate how well they match.

name: Pose and refine a question
description: Student can pose and refine a question for a statistical investigation.
exampleOfSuccess: The student narrows a broad question into one that can be answered with data.
commonError: Student poses a question that cannot be answered by collecting data.
checkpointTask: Ask the student to pose and refine a question for an investigation.

name: Collect relevant data
description: Student can collect relevant data for their investigation, using suitable tools.
exampleOfSuccess: The student uses a spreadsheet to record collected data.
commonError: Student collects data that does not address the question.
checkpointTask: Have the student collect data for a planned investigation.

name: Analyse and interpret the data
description: Student can analyse and interpret their investigation data.
exampleOfSuccess: The student finds the mode and range and describes the distribution.
commonError: Student reports raw data without analysing it.
checkpointTask: Ask the student to analyse their investigation data.

name: Communicate the findings
description: Student can communicate the findings within the context of the investigation.
exampleOfSuccess: The student reports what the data shows about the original question.
commonError: Student reports numbers without answering the question.
checkpointTask: After the investigation, ask the student what the data shows about the question.
